name: Awesome Foundation Conservation and Climate microgrants

funder.name: The Awesome Foundation (Conservation and Climate chapter)

administered_by.name: Awesome Foundation Conservation and Climate chapter

summary: Volunteer-funded micro-grants of around US$1,000 for individuals or small teams with innovative wildlife, habitat protection or climate projects. Salaries, operating costs and established projects are not funded.

amount.note: Projects that have a "tipping point" of $1000 or less

reporting: Send a note on the impact, along with photos and/or video when the project is done

administered_by.quote: Each chapter of the Awesome Foundation is volunteer-run and self-funded by a group of people who pool their money to form micro-grants

applicant_types.quote: If you are an individual or small team, with an awesome idea that will help the environment, you are encouraged to apply.

geography.quote: Worldwide Conservation and Climate Disability Dragon Dreaming On the Water

access.quote: If you are an individual or small team, with an awesome idea that will help the environment, you are encouraged to apply.

amount.quote: Projects that have a "tipping point" of $1000 or less where our grant will be the difference between it not happening and making dreams come true.

reporting.quote: If you are funded, we hope you will send us a note on the impact, along with photos and/or video when you are done, so we can share the joy on our webpage and social media.
